description: US mechanics lien and preliminary notice deadlines for construction material suppliers. Start with v3 discovery for current jurisdiction-specific scope support and exact rule identities; v2 delivery-event baselines cover Florida and Kansas private projects. Supplier discovery and calculations require a customer key. Discovery uses no calculation allowance; completed calculations consume plan allowance. Statute-cited editorial lien guides for all 50 states and DC are public without a key.
